items.title: Nightly Unicommerce backfill
items.detail: Re-syncs the last two days every night and retries timeouts.

items.title: Smarter courier scoring
items.detail: RTO and NDR on closed shipments, cost by pickup zone.

items.title: Roadmap and onboarding guide
items.detail: A written data platform roadmap, and a guide for new analytics team members.

items.title: Ops summary with projected RTO
items.detail: Ops summary that counts orders stuck in transit for more than 15 days as RTO, so the RTO % isn't understated for recent weeks.

explain.simple: Orders stuck for over 15 days are treated as returns, giving a truer RTO number.
explain.technical: reporting.ops_report_orders, Shopify; high-aging (>15 days, not delivered) counted as RTO; date field filter, default previous 30 days.

items.title: RTO by state, city and pincode, COD vs Prepaid
items.detail: Three queries ranking states, cities and pincodes by RTO %, split COD vs Prepaid. Pincodes are listed only for flagged states (COD RTO above 14% and COD share 15 points above prepaid).

explain.simple: Shows which places return the most orders, separately for cash-on-delivery and prepaid.
explain.technical: reporting.ops_report_orders x staging.orders, Shopify; flagged state = COD RTO% > 14 and COD share % - prepaid share % > 15; min-orders filter on city.
